title: [Bug]: GroupChat cannot run with MCP tool call (async await issue)
body: ### Describe the bug When I using GroupChat, I want to test it through a python test file. All the initialization worked correctly, but when it start using tool call, it will crash due to `RuntimeError: This event loop is already running`, since I start the test with `asyncio.run()`, causing the event loop already existed. In the source code of `conversable_agent.py`, the `generate_tool_calls_reply` function is called when using tool call and been programmed in line:2414 to do `_, func_return = loop.run_until_complete(self.a_execute_function(function_call, call_id=tool_call_id))` which will use asyncio to check if there are a event loop running. Not sure if I am doing it wrong or it is a bug. Additionally, what does this means? I didn't do any function call manually. `sys:1: RuntimeWarning: coroutine 'ConversableAgent.a_execute_function' was never awaited` ### Steps to reproduce Orchestrator.py ```python class Orchestrator: def __init__(self): # self.intent_agent = IntentAgent() self.planner_agent = PlannerAgent() self.blockchain_agent = BlockchainAgent() self.user_agent = UserProxyAgent( name="user_agent", human_input_mode="NEVER", code_execution_config = { "use_docker": False }, ) # def classify(self, user_input: str): # intent = self.intent_agent.execute_function("classify", user_input) # return intent async def run(self, user_input: str): llm_config = Config.get_anthropic_llm_config() # server_params = StdioServerParameters( # command="node", # The command to run the server # args=[ # "src/mcp/evm-mcp-server/build/index.js", # ], # ) await self.planner_agent.register_mcp_tools_for_llm("node", ["src/mcp/evm-mcp-server/build/index.js"], mode="stdio") await self.blockchain_agent.register_mcp_tools_for_execution("node", ["src/mcp/evm-mcp-server/build/index.js"], mode="stdio") logger.info("[Orchestrator] MCP tools registered") pattern = AutoPattern( initial_agent=self.planner_agent, agents=[ self.planner_agent, self.blockchain_agent ], user_agent=self.user_agent, group_manager_args = {"llm_config": llm_config}, ) result, context, last_agent = await a_initiate_group_chat( pattern=pattern, messages=user_input, max_rounds=7 ) return result, context, last_agent ``` test_orchestrator.py ```python async def test_orchestrator(): orchestrator = Orchestrator() user_input = "Do I have 10 DAI on Optimism? My address is 0x1234567890123456789012345678901234567890, I want to send 10 DAI to peter, his address is peter.eth" result, context, last_agent = await orchestrator.run(user_input) print("Result: ", result.summary) if __name__ == "__main__": asyncio.run(test_orchestrator()) ``` ### Model Used Antropic sonnet 3.7 ### Expected Behavior Complete a tool call and retrieve the information. ### Screenshots and logs Trackback: ```bash Traceback (most recent call last): File "/Users/bbb/Desktop/blockchain-llm-agent/tests/test_orchestrator.py", line 14, in asyncio.run(test_orchestrator()) File "/Users/bbb/.local/share/uv/python/cpython-3.12.9-macos-aarch64-none/lib/python3.12/asyncio/runners.py", line 195, in run return runner.run(main) ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ File "/Users/bbb/.local/share/uv/python/cpython-3.12.9-macos-aarch64-none/lib/python3.12/asyncio/runners.py", line 118, in run return self._loop.run_until_complete(task) ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ File "/Users/bbb/.local/share/uv/python/cpython-3.12.9-macos-aarch64-none/lib/python3.12/asyncio/base_events.py", line 691, in run_until_complete return future.result() ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ File "/Users/bbb/Desktop/blockchain-llm-agent/tests/test_orchestrator.py", line 10, in test_orchestrator result, context, last_agent = await orchestrator.run(user_input) ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ File "/Users/bbb/Desktop/blockchain-llm-agent/src/agent/orchestrator.py", line 58, in run result, context, last_agent = await a_initiate_group_chat( ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ File "/Users/bbb/Desktop/blockchain-llm-agent/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/autogen/agentchat/group/multi_agent_chat.py", line 134, in a_initiate_group_chat chat_result = await last_agent.a_initiate_chat( ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ File "/Users/bbb/Desktop/blockchain-llm-agent/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/autogen/agentchat/conversable_agent.py", line 1657, in a_initiate_chat await self.a_send(msg2send, recipient, silent=silent) File "/Users/bbb/Desktop/blockchain-llm-agent/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/autogen/agentchat/conversable_agent.py", line self.a_generate_reply(messages=self.chat_messages[sender], sender=sender) ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ File "/Users/bbb/Desktop/blockchain-llm-agent/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/autogen/agentchat/conversable_agent.py", line 2898, in a_generate_reply final, reply = await reply_func( ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ RuntimeError: This event loop is already running sys:1: RuntimeWarning: coroutine 'ConversableAgent.a_execute_function' was never awaited ``` ### Additional Information Package Name & Version: ai_judgment.response:
**Yes**

This is an agent issue because it involves a failure in tool invocation (`generate_tool_calls_reply` function) within an LLM-based agent system. The issue specifically pertains to the use of asynchronous tool calls and the event loop, which is a component of the agent's tool-handling capabilities.
